content.short: Stake SUI for sSUI with SpringSui, the liquid staking standard from the team behind Suilend.
content.description: Stake SUI through SpringSui and you get sSUI, a token that earns validator rewards and can still be lent, traded or used as collateral. The standard is open, so other teams can launch their own liquid staking tokens on the same base. It was built by the team behind Suilend, one of Sui's main lending markets, and works closely with it. Any team can use the SpringSui Standard to create its own ecosystem LST, and staking into sSUI has no fee while unstaking carries a very small one.
